normalize_split_default: normalize a torch.split node in an FX graph by converting split_size to explicit split_sections
normalize_cat_default: normalize a torch.cat node in an FX graph by ensuring dim is properly resolved and example_value metadata is present
normalize_stack_default: normalize a torch.stack node in an FX graph by resolving dim and validating example_value metadata
merge_splits: merge two consecutive split operations into a single split by combining their split sections
simplify_split_cat: simplify a split-then-cat pattern by removing or merging the split node based on user input ranges
merge_split_squeeze: replace split-then-getitem-then-squeeze patterns with torch.unbind for optimization
merge_unbind_stack: merge unbind-then-stack/cat patterns by applying transform parameters like movedim and flatten
merge_getitem_cat: merge consecutive getitem indices into a single split section when feeding into a cat node
merge_stack_tanh_unbind: merge stack-tanh-unbind patterns by replacing unbind with split and consolidating indices
SplitCatSimplifier.simplify: simplify split-cat patterns by analyzing user inputs, computing transform params, and replacing nodes
UnbindCatRemover.remove_unbind: remove unbind nodes by treating them as size-one splits and applying SplitCatSimplifier logic
